name: Harmonic key shift
lesson:
## Make the key fit before you press play

B is one semitone below a compatible key. In the bar before bar 9, press the KEY SHIFT pad that raises B one semitone (pad 5 here, the first step up from the original; remap the lane if your software puts it elsewhere), then play B on the one and blend. Once B carries the mix, step it back to its original key on the bar before 25, when A is gone.

The Camelot rule: same code, one step either side, or the A/B pair. A one-semitone shift moves a track seven steps around the wheel, which is exactly what you need when two tracks are a semitone apart. Shift with the incoming track silent and shift back once nothing else is playing; a key shift in the middle of a blend is audible.

tracks.cue: A on the piano riff: 6A. Melodic content makes the semitone shift on B audible.
B is 6B, one Camelot step away: load it a semitone down in rekordbox first, then press the KEY SHIFT pad that raises it back before playing on the one.
